name: "Ghost Face Caught on Tape"

description.content: Instantly recharges [Night Shroud] after a basic attack puts a Survivor into the Dying State.

quote: "In this footage, a dark figure is seen entering a house late at night in Northern Roseville, Florida. The police were called the next morning to report a murder in the area. Lock your doors: a killer is in our midst, roaming freely, like a Ghost in the night." -The Roseville Gazette
